query:
# For each constraint statement on spouse (P26), the number of statements for
# which the query service holds a recorded violation of it. A calibration:
# recorded violations cover only entities whose constraints have been checked,
# so these are lower bounds on what the checker would report.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?c ?type ?typeLabel (COUNT(?st) AS ?statements) WHERE {
  wd:P26 p:P2302 ?c .
  ?c ps:P2302 ?type .
  OPTIONAL { ?st wikibase:hasViolationForConstraint ?c }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
GROUP BY ?c ?type ?typeLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?statements)
